decision.record: logs/budget/decisions.md 2026-10-20 (Stage-0 volume study: Top-4 recovery extension)

relation_to_the_preregistration.unchanged: every dose's D1 full search, its committed Top-1 (finalists_k = 1), that Top-1's fixed recovery at seed 20260726 on the A100 and its eval-set-1 measurement, and every preregistered H1/H2/H3 contrast. The extension adds units beside them; it changes none of them and its numbers never enter a preregistered contrast.

candidates.rule: each dose's complete leaves in its own search's quality order (stage1_selection.json :: decisions, policy beam.pareto_multi_objective@v2, lineage diversity NOT applied), byte-identical leaves (same checkpoint sha256) counted once with the better-ranked state standing for both, first 4 (finalists.distinct_finalists)
candidates.why_distinct: d2's quality positions 1 and 2 (and 4 and 5) are the same weights: DEPTH removed the same eight layers under both calibration profiles, so every descendant built on the two DEPTH states is identical; recovering one model twice at one seed would measure only GPU nondeterminism
candidates.d4: derived by the same rule from d4's own search when it completes (dose_d4 session, stage X_export)

d1.why: d1's Top-2..4 were retired with its other states before the extension existed (decisions.md 2026-10-19); the tombstone kept their digests and the journal their ancestry
d1.mechanism: digest-pinned fixed-path replay (stages.phase_d1.replay_specs + materialize_fixed_path) under the Stage-0 search's owners, every intermediate pinned to its recorded artifact digest and operator config hash; root state, operator configs and execution knobs agreed at $0 before any pod; adopted only when artifact digest, weights digest, shard sha256 and arch signature all match
d1.hardware: the A100-SXM4-80GB the search ran on (the success criterion is byte equality)
d1.on_mismatch: that candidate is not adopted and not substituted; the mismatch is diagnosed (P12.1: a wrong replay mechanism is an engineering failure, a reproduced mechanism that still disagrees is material and is reported)

seeds._why: 20260726 is the preregistered recovery seed (the A100 Top-1 unit already holds it); 20260727 is the second seed, fixed here before any probe ran

units.recovery: the frozen recipe e1_p1_kd_heavy@0.86M (configs/stages/stage-3/e1/e1_r0860k_sa_pca.json) by the C1 trainer through dose_driver.train_recovery; only run identity, out_dir, pack path, student_path and seed differ (C1_PROBE_OVERRIDES, checked)
units.evaluation: every item of eval-set-1 at its preregistered identity, the dose session's own dose_driver.evaluate_all (trained 8,192-token context, action protocol v2, formal scoring protocol v2)

hardware.cloud: secure (a network volume attaches only there)
hardware.data_center: US-TX-3 (the only datacenter with storage support and L40S stock on 2026-10-20)
hardware.durability: a network volume in that datacenter holds every recovered student and generation as it finishes; the candidates reach it from the relay (AlphaAvatar/aadistill-artifacts, stage0_calvol/finalists/...), sha256-pinned

units.hardware_note: the Top-1 seed-20260726 unit ran on an A100 and every extension unit runs on an L40S, so a contrast with the A100 unit differs in hardware as well as in seed or candidate and is reported as such, never attributed to one of them

analysis.per_unit: every unit and capability's formal numbers exactly as the dose report gives them (no pooled score), usable_rollout with every component, and the recovery's training record
within_dose: rank k vs rank 1 at seed 20260727 (same L40S, same seed): task-paired differences with the preregistration's bootstrap intervals and SESOI labels
seed 20260726 vs 20260727 for ranks 2..4 (same L40S, same candidate): the seed-to-seed spread, the reference every candidate difference is read against
rank 1 on the A100 at 20260726 beside rank 1 on the L40S at 20260727: reported, not attributed (hardware and seed both differ)
search quality order beside recovered outcome, per dose: described (n = 4 candidates), never tested
analysis.across_doses: the 1x/2x/4x shape of the above, described
analysis.floor: where both rates in a contrast are at the floor (0 correct), the label is reported with a floor flag; a NO-GO at the floor says nothing about whether the factor matters
not_claimed: that search rank predicts recovered capability
anything the preregistered H1/H2/H3 did not register

retry_policy: the preregistration's: before a unit's measurement begins, ordinary failures are repaired and retried (P12.1); after it begins, the SAME unit resumes from the network volume -- a trained student is evaluated rather than retrained, finished generations rescored rather than regenerated; never a second complete measurement of a unit

budget.maintainer: +$30 on the Stage-0 programme (decision 2026-10-20): formal_volume $90 -> $120, programme ceiling $107.5099 -> $137.5099, project cap $607.6571 -> $637.6571; per-session cap $50 unchanged

estimate_2026_10_20.basis: L40S securePrice $1.09/h and A100 $1.79/h (provider, 2026-10-20); recovery 62 min on an L40S measured for this recipe (D2 confirmation probes, 1,020 steps in about 60 min); eval-set-1 on an L40S NOT measured -- 1.3x to 1.8x the A100's 49 min assumed

budget.rule: every session's hard cap must fit the remaining envelope; after the first probe session's first unit the per-unit cost is re-priced from its measured minutes, and if the remaining units' expected cost plus $5 does not fit, no further probe session is launched until the maintainer decides

authorizes: nothing; each session runs only through its own one-use authorization
